description: This file defines the QhullRidge class, representing a ridge in the Qhull computational geometry library. It includes class declarations, constructors, accessors, and related typedefs, along with external operator overloads.

classes.name: QhullRidge
classes.description: Represents a ridge (a simplex of dimension hull_dim-1) between two neighboring facets in the Qhull library, including methods for accessing related geometric and topological information.

methods.name: QhullRidge()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to an empty ridge.

methods.name: QhullRidge(const Qhull &q)
methods.description: Constructor creating a ridge associated with a specific Qhull instance.

methods.name: QhullRidge(const Qhull &q, ridgeT *r)
methods.description: Constructor creating a ridge with a specific ridgeT pointer.

methods.name: QhullRidge(QhullQh *qqh)
methods.description: Constructor creating a ridge with a QhullQh context.

methods.name: QhullRidge(QhullQh *qqh, ridgeT *r)
methods.description: Constructor creating a ridge with specific QhullQh context and ridgeT pointer.

methods.name: operator=(const QhullRidge &other)
methods.description: Assignment operator copying ridge and QhullQh pointers.

methods.name: bottomFacet()
methods.description: Returns the bottom facet of the ridge.

methods.name: dimension()
methods.description: Returns the dimension of the ridge.

methods.name: getBaseT()
methods.description: Returns the base ridgeT pointer for use in QhullSet.

methods.name: getRidgeT()
methods.description: Returns the internal ridgeT pointer.

methods.name: id()
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the ridge.

methods.name: isValid()
methods.description: Checks if the ridge object is valid.

methods.name: operator==(const QhullRidge &other)
methods.description: Equality comparison based on internal ridge pointer.

methods.name: operator!=(const QhullRidge &other)
methods.description: Inequality comparison.

methods.name: otherFacet(const QhullFacet &f)
methods.description: Returns the facet on the opposite side of the ridge from the given facet.

methods.name: qh()
methods.description: Returns the associated QhullQh context.

methods.name: setRidgeT(QhullQh *qqh, ridgeT *ridge)
methods.description: Sets the internal ridgeT pointer and QhullQh context.

methods.name: topFacet()
methods.description: Returns the top facet of the ridge.

methods.name: hasNextRidge3d(const QhullFacet &f)
methods.description: Checks if there is a next ridge in 3D context.

methods.name: nextRidge3d(const QhullFacet &f, QhullVertex *nextVertex)
methods.description: Returns the next ridge in 3D context.

methods.name: vertices()
methods.description: Returns the set of vertices forming the ridge.

methods.name: print(const char* message)
methods.description: Returns a PrintRidge object for formatted output.
